Physical examination reveals that blistering is not present in her oral mucosa, and the epidermis does not separate upon light stroking of the skin. The patient most likely suffers from a hypersensitivity reaction located:?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Linearly along the epidermal basement membrane
opb. In net-like patterns around epidermal cells
opc. In granular deposits at the tips of dermal papillae
opd. In fat cells beneath the skin
ope. In nuclei within epidermal cells

The patient most likely suffers from a hypersensitivity reaction located linearly along the epidermal basement membrane. This is supported by the absence of blistering in the oral mucosa and the lack of epidermal separation upon light stroking of the skin. Evidence paths confirm interactions with epidermal cells, aligning with the consensus that the reaction is along the epidermal basement membrane.
